items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: So I had these four records, you know the LPs and a changer. And every day after school that’s what I did. I practiced.

ctx.x: Yep. That’s why I think he, this guy was like I say, he was really organized in his thoughts and his work. So I had these four records, you know the LPs and a changer. And every day after school that’s what I did. I practiced. I did my homework first, always. My schoolwork. And so then I did my trumpet until dinner. I did my homework while my mom was cooking I did it in the kitchen at the table. And she was cooking and I said [sniffs] “Oh what is that, Mom? That smells really good.” And that’s how I learned to…
Can you define what you were — how were you practicing? Were you copying?
